result.keywords: This article examines modular agricultural habitats for low-gravity environments, emphasizing thermal zoning, water reclamation, and adaptive illumination schedules for long-duration crew support. A case study is presented for a fictional lunar habitat prototype using layered growing trays, biofilter loops, and autonomous pollination drones. The discussion focuses on systems integration, yield stability, and maintenance planning rather than control theory or human-machine sensing.
result.title: Mosaic Cartography of Lunar Greenhouses.
